en: \rFlannery: Your fiery passion! It's gonna overheat!
\rFlannery: Wait, we're totally gonna win together, right?
\rFlannery: Bye-bye!
\bNorman: Let me show you my newly honed skills.
\bNorman: You better give it your best shot!
\bNorman: Take care.
\rWinona: Witness our elegant choreography!
\rWinona: With splendor!
\rWinona: Until later then.
\bTate: We're gonna surprise you! \rLiza: Our awesome, powerful combination!
\bTate: I sense we'll work well together!
\rLiza: See ya!
\bJuan: I care about winning beautifully!
\bJuan: Please, they shall bear witness to our artistry.
\bJuan: Ahahaha!
\bSidney: I think we'll have fun with this.
\bSidney: Nothing's gonna stop us!
\bSidney: Later!
\rPhoebe: Just see if they can even touch my Pokémon!
\rPhoebe: I already foresee a bond between us!
\rPhoebe: See you again!
\rGlacia: Sigh. So many weak opponents.
\rGlacia: I sincerely hope you can show me a bit more fun than the last few.
\rGlacia: Farewell.
\bDrake: A team's true worth is in the strength of their spirit!
\bDrake: Let us press onward together!
\bDrake: Farewell!!
\bSteven: When it comes down to it, I'm just the strongest there is right now.
\bSteven: Imagine what we could do as a team.
\bSteven: See you around.
\bWallace: I represent beauty as well as intelligence.
\bWallace: And I want to feel bedazzled by your masterful performance.
\bWallace: I'll be seeing you.
\bWally: My Pokémon have given me the courage and strength to fight. I have to win for their sake!
\bWally: I promise, I won't let you down.
\bWally: Bye!
\rMay: I'm going to try to find what I can do to help!
\rMay: I was hoping you'd decide to take me with you!
\rMay: Bye!
\bBrendan: If you ever need help, give me a call! I'm your guy!
\bBrendan: I'm going with you! Let's show 'em what we're made of!
\bBrendan: See ya.
\bBirch: Imagine seeing you here!
\bBirch: Alright, we will get the hang of this.
\bBirch: Sure!
\bMaxie: To propel humanity to greater heights of progress and evolution.
\bMaxie: I see you require my help. And thus, we become the strongest.
\bMaxie: Farewell.
\bArchie: To return everything to its unspoiled beginnings!
\bArchie: No question about it. Bwahaha! Leave it to me!
\bArchie: See ya later.
\bRoark: We will smash our way through any obstacle.
\bRoark: I'll show you this tough coal miner's true strength.
\bRoark: See you around.
\rGardenia: Today is another day where we can give it our all!
\rGardenia: When it comes to plant Pokémon, you can't go wrong with me.
\rGardenia: Bye bye! Catch you later!
\rMaylene: I'll accept an invitation anytime, anywhere!
\rMaylene: Can I come with you?
\rMaylene: Bye.
\bCrasher Wake: The torrential masked master will wash them all away!
\bCrasher Wake: Feast your eyes on the monster wave that I bring!
\bCrasher Wake: So long!
\rFantina: You wish to see me dance, yes?
\rFantina: You choose me? Oh, no, I choose you!
\rFantina: Au revoir!
\bByron: I have the confidence to batter down any defenses!
\bByron: This is where we make our stand!
\rCandice: My focus can melt ice! I'm ready to go.
\rCandice: I'll show you, so you better be ready!
\rCandice: Got it!
\bVolkner: Every one of my Pokémon are top class in potential.
\bVolkner: You need my help? Ehh, sure.
\bVolkner: Later.
\bAaron: Let's give it our best shot.
\bAaron: Later!
\rBertha: Well, would you show this old lady how much you've learned?
\rBertha: Don't worry. This old lady has your back.
\rBertha: Next time then.
\bFlint: I can feel your determination. Your will is truly on fire!
